jobs.detail: LEVER PREACHER CURL, front-side three-quarter view, facing IMAGE RIGHT. Seated upright on preacher-curl leverage machine, feet flat, chest close to preacher pad. BOTH upper arms supported along sloped preacher pad, elbows stay planted at pad lower edge, shoulders do not lift. Both hands grip connected horizontal handles UNDERHAND with palms UP, thumbs around grips, wrists neutral. Fixed machine rotation axle directly aligned with ELBOW joint axis. A single rigid moving arm connects axle to handlebar, SAME length and geometry in both panels, simple clear linkage to weight stack. LEFT start lower forearms extended forward/down with slight elbow softness, no hyperextension. RIGHT curl both forearms UP toward shoulders by flexing elbows, handles lift while elbows/upper arms remain ON pad; no shoulder lift or torso swing. Both handles remain visibly connected to the SAME rigid lever rotating around SAME elbow-axis pivot. Red on exposed BICEPS ONLY on both upper arms. Forearms, shoulders, all other exposed anatomy grayscale; entire shirt/shorts BLACK.
jobs.prompt: Edit ONLY HANDS and wrist rotation in BOTH panels of this original project male preacher curl. Correct to SUPINATED UNDERHAND grip on the SAME horizontal handles. No knuckles on top of bar. In RIGHT curled phase maintain same supination: palms face athlete's own face and biceps, back of hands faces away from him. Five realistic fingers, neutral straight wrists, no extra joints. Upper arms/elbows planted on preacher pad, biceps red, rest grayscale, black clothing fully opaque. Keep all machinery, body position, panel layout and dimensions unchanged. No text.

poses.caption: Sit supported and hold overhand handles with arms open and elbows softly bent
Bring handles together in front of chest while keeping the same gentle elbow bend

jobs.detail: LEVER SEATED FLY, FRONT three-quarter view. Seated pelvis/back supported against upright backrest, feet flat shoulder width. Chest fly leverage machine has two independent rigid arms pivoting around two FIXED vertical axes above and behind respective shoulders, weight stack cable resistance. Both hands grasp HORIZONTAL handles with PRONATED palms DOWN grip and thumbs wrapped, not vertical neutral grips. Elbows slightly bent and FIXED bend throughout; movement is bringing upper arms together at SHOULDERS, NOT bending elbows like chest press. LEFT start upper arms opened laterally to sides at chest/shoulder height, shoulders not hyperextended behind torso. RIGHT sweep SAME handles and arms forward/inward in arcs until handles nearly meet directly in FRONT of mid chest, arms still gently bent. Torso stays against pad, no shrug or elbow-flexion curl. Same lever lengths/fixed pivots/frame/base across panels, no detached handles or extra equipment. Entire wide-open apparatus and arms fit inside left panel. Primary PECTORALS only very soft DIFFUSE RED tint on continuous OPAQUE BLACK CHEST fabric, no visible pectoral fiber pattern/divisions/nipple details through cloth; shoulders/arms grayscale.
